blocks.text: Catalytic converter chhatte (honeycomb) jaisi banawat wala ceramic ya dhati monolith hai (Figure 12.6). Us ke andaroni channels par zyada satah dene ke liye alumina ki tah hai, aur mehngi noble metals platinum, palladium aur rhodium alumina par phaili hain. Yeh metals teen redox reactions catalyse karte hain jo nuqsan-deh exhaust gases hatate hain: three-way converter nuqsan-deh CO, NO aur hydrocarbons ko CO2, N2 aur pani mein badalta hai. Yeh qeemti metals recycle bhi ho sakte hain. Reduction: 2NO(g) + 2CO(g) Pt/Rh par N2(g) + 2CO2(g). Oxidation: 2CO(g) + O2(g) Pt/Rh par 2CO2(g), aur C2H4 + 3O2 se 2CO2 + 2H2O (print mein 2C2H4 + 6O2 se 4CO2 + 4H2O).

blocks.alt: Kata hua catalytic converter: engine se HC, CO aur NOx wala dhuan baen se dakhil ho kar do ceramic honeycomb monolith blocks se guzarta hai aur daen se CO2, H2O aur N2 ban kar nikalta hai. Labels kehte hain har nali mein Pt, Pd aur Rh wali alumina ki teh (washcoat) hai. Dabba reactions deta hai: 2NO + 2CO -> N2 + 2CO2 (reduction); 2CO + O2 -> 2CO2 aur C2H4 + 3O2 -> 2CO2 + 2H2O (oxidation).
blocks.caption: Three-way catalytic converter (Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Catalytic converter ka bunyadi usool kya hai, aur kya hybrid aur electric cars mein yeh hote hain (Quick Check 12.3b, c)?
blocks.explanation: Garam exhaust chhatte mein alumina par platinum, palladium aur rhodium ki bari satah par se guzarta hai; metals NO ki CO se nitrogen mein reduction aur CO aur bina jale hydrocarbons ki CO2 aur pani mein oxidation catalyse karte hain, khud kharch hue baghair. Hybrid cars phir bhi petrol jalati hain, to un mein converters hote hain; mukammal electric cars mein engine ka exhaust nahi hota to unhen zaroorat nahi.

items: Chhatte jaisa monolith, alumina washcoat, Pt/Pd/Rh; teen redox reactions: 2NO + 2CO se N2 + 2CO2 (reduction), 2CO + O2 se 2CO2 aur C2H4 + 3O2 se 2CO2 + 2H2O (oxidation); metals recyclable.
